summary: Iter 216h24 (P6 — Staff Onboarding Wizard) - 10/10 backend tests PASSED, frontend E2E wizard flow PASSED. The 5-step wizard (Identity → Role → Sites → Modules → Review) works correctly. All 4 backend endpoints used by the wizard verified: POST /api/master-admin/organizations/{org_id}/users, POST /api/master-admin/pulse-admins, PUT /api/master-admin/users/{user_id}/edit, POST /api/master-admin/users/{user_id}/invite-link. Invite link generated with /reset-password?token= format. Pulse Master Admin scope correctly hides 'GymAxis Master Admin' role tile and forces Pulse brand. Regression: People → Directory still shows unified list with 110 users.

test_1_wizard_loads.details: Staff Onboarding Wizard loads at /master-admin?section=staff-onboarding with data-testid=staff-onboarding-wizard. All 5 step pills visible (identity, role, sites, modules, review).

test_2_step1_identity_validation.details: Next button disabled until name >= 2 chars AND email matches regex. Brand context toggle visible for GymAxis admin (Pulse Fitness / GymAxis).

test_3_step2_role_tiles.details: 7 role tiles in 2 groups (Platform: master_admin, pulse_master_admin, service_desk; Customer org: owner, manager, staff, instructor). Org dropdown appears for org-scoped roles.

test_4_step3_sites.details: Sites list loads from /api/master-admin/organizations/{org_id}/sites. Empty selection = all sites.

test_5_step4_modules.details: 4 module toggles (operations, memberships, marketing, crm). Toggling OFF sends module_overrides={marketing:false} to backend.

test_6_happy_path_e2e.details: Full wizard flow: name='Onboard Test User', email='onboard.test.{timestamp}@example.com', role='staff', org selected, sites empty, marketing OFF. Result panel shows invite link with /reset-password?token=. Copy and Email buttons visible.

test_7_pulse_admin_scope.details: Pulse Master Admin (pulse.scope.test@pulsefitness.com): 'GymAxis Master Admin' role tile HIDDEN, brand toggle HIDDEN (Pulse scope forced), org dropdown shows only 2 Pulse-brand orgs.

test_8_backend_create_org_user.details: POST /api/master-admin/organizations/{org_id}/users creates user and returns invite_url with 72h token.

test_11_user_in_directory.details: Created user appears in GET /api/master-admin/users unified directory.

test_12_regression_directory.details: People → Directory still shows unified list (110 users). Sub-tabs visible: Directory, Onboard staff, Site-locked users.

critical_code_review_comments: StaffOnboardingWizard.js correctly implements 5-step linear flow with local state management
Wizard correctly calls 4 backend endpoints in sequence: create user → edit (module_overrides) → invite-link (if needed)
Pulse admin scope correctly filters role tiles (hides master_admin) and forces brand='pulse'
SidebarConfig.js correctly defines 'staff-onboarding' sub-tab under 'roles' (People) group
MasterAdminPage.js correctly renders StaffOnboardingWizard for section='staff-onboarding' with isPulseAdmin prop
